# `prefer-count-scalar`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: none · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports a loop that increments one counter for elements equal to one scalar.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

`std.mem.countScalar` names the counting operation and keeps its accumulator
internal.

## When it fires

The zero-initialized counter must be immediately followed by a single-capture
loop whose only body is the equality test and unit increment.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn countOf(values: []const u8, needle: u8) usize {
    var count: usize = 0;
    for (values) |value| {
        if (value == needle) {
            count += 1;
        }
    }
    return count;
}
```
